description: Taxable Australian sale. Reports GST collected at 1A and gross/net sale at G1 depending BAS method.
name: GST on Sales

description: GST-free domestic sale; no GST charged but related input tax credits may generally be claimable.
name: GST-free Sales

description: Export sale or GST-free supply to overseas customer where requirements are met; usually relevant to G2/G3 style reporting.
name: GST-free Export Sales

description: Input-taxed sale such as many residential rents and financial supplies; GST is not charged and related credits may be restricted.
name: Input-taxed Sales / Financial Supplies

description: Credit notes, discounts, refunds, bad debt adjustments and other output tax adjustments.
name: GST Sales Adjustment

description: Creditable business acquisition where GST credit is claimable. Usually BAS 1B and G11.
name: GST on Purchases

description: Creditable acquisition of capital assets. Usually BAS 1B and G10.
name: GST on Capital Purchases

description: Purchase that has no GST in price but is still a business acquisition.
name: GST-free Purchase

description: Purchase connected with input-taxed activities, or financial acquisition where credits may be restricted.
name: Input-taxed / No-credit Purchase

description: Supplier credit notes, rebates, refunds, bad debt adjustments and input tax credit adjustments.
name: GST Purchase Adjustment

description: GST paid or deferred on taxable importations.
name: Import GST

description: Imported services, digital products or cross-border supplies requiring review for GST treatment.
name: Imported Services / Reverse Charge Review

description: Accounting or non-GST movement not reported as a taxable/GST-free/input-taxed sale or purchase on BAS.
name: BAS Excluded / Not Reportable on BAS

description: Balance sheet transfers, equity movements, non-supply movements, pure financing principal and other out-of-scope transactions.
name: No Tax / Out of Scope

description: System/control code for GST paid, collected, payable, receivable, clearing and BAS settlement accounts.
name: GST Control Account

description: PAYG withholding liabilities and remittances.
name: PAYG Withholding Control

description: Employer superannuation payable and remittances.
name: Superannuation Payable Control

description: State payroll tax payable and settlement.
name: Payroll Tax Control

description: Workers compensation payable or accrual control.
name: Workers Compensation Control

description: Company income tax receivable/payable and PAYG instalments.
name: Income Tax Control

description: Current/deferred income tax expense accounts.
name: Income Tax Expense

description: Deferred tax asset/liability and deferred tax movements.
name: Deferred Tax Control

description: FBT payable or expense control.
name: Fringe Benefits Tax Control

description: Land tax, council rates, water rates and similar statutory property charges where no GST credit applies.
name: Land Tax / Rates Control

description: Stamp duty, transfer duty and property transaction duty accounts.
name: Stamp Duty / Transfer Duty Control

description: Foreign withholding tax deducted from dividends, interest, royalties or distributions.
name: Foreign Withholding Tax

description: Franking credits receivable or franking memo tracking.
name: Franking Credit / Franking Account

description: Expenses requiring tax add-back or special tax treatment.
name: Non-deductible Expense

description: Private, mixed-use or non-business expense requiring review.
name: Private / Non-business

description: Government grants and subsidies; GST depends on whether the grant is consideration for a supply.
name: Grant Income Review

description: Insurance claim receipts requiring review for GST adjustment or non-GST treatment.
name: Insurance Recovery Review

description: Property purchase/sale/settlement items requiring review: residential, commercial, going concern, margin scheme or capital asset treatment.
name: Property Transaction Review

description: Interest, loans, dividends, securities and investment dealings where GST/input-taxed rules may apply.
name: Financial Supply Review

description: Small BAS/GST rounding differences.
name: GST Rounding

description: Budget, memo, KPI, statistical and other non-posting accounts.
name: Not Applicable
